title: Went back to art school, the building would be unmistakable if you’ve been there.
content: There is a full room made of a beautiful mosaic of stained glass you can stand and dance on. The building is super old with a gothic architectural style. The professors are incredible but the building itself has some bad juju. Cobble streets outside. It’s grim with stain glass like colors where there is color, reflecting the floor in the building. It’s beautiful and haunting. I just moved into a dorm type location and am meeting people. Good and bad.
